data.text: Start spawning an archived creature as an ally until Stat spent rounds to that creature's Stats. When creature vanishes it goes back to archives. Alt (Death Ward): on target's death, move it out of dimension with 1 life.

logic.description: Implemented stat buy (channeling). Three-way (pc ruling): a dead unit lying adjacent to the caster is raised (a player with full life; a monster becomes the caster ally) — it must still lie there at completion; else an archived creature is spawned as an ally (need = its stat sum); else a Death Ward is put on a right-clicked living adjacent ally: when that ally would die the damage is cut so it keeps 1 HP, it is moved to its entry hex if free, and the ward is spent (need 0 for a ward). Every emission banks the caster stat behind the element going out (card elements round-robin) until the bank is at least the need (the raised / spawned unit stat sum, 0 for a Death Ward); no dice, so nothing fails — a low stat only takes longer. The creature appears as the caster ally on completion and the card stays as a permanent with FIXED power 6 (Rule 24: the destroyer needs a 6); on destruction the creature vanishes and its card goes to the owner archive. With nothing to raise, spawn or ward the cast fizzles. Vitality is the only element, so every emission banks the caster Vitality.

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).
A right-clicked target (Death Ward) must be a living ally in contact; dead adjacent units are the raise targets; no target means spawn from the archive.

effects.description: Every emission banks the caster stat behind the element going out (card elements round-robin: emission k banks element k mod |elements|); no dice, nothing fails.
The cast completes once the bank is at least the need (the unit stat sum, 0 for a ward).
Upper bound of emissions at the caster current stats: need ÷ the smallest stat the card elements bank, rounded up (the k/n cast length shown in the UI).
Stat-buy summons are always cast with tokens of value 6 (fixed power, no die rolled at placement).
Rule 24 with fixed power: the destroyer needs a 6. On destruction the creature vanishes and its card goes to the owner archive.
Life a warded ally keeps when it would die.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_vitality (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.
